title: visitLog
description: Schema for a document in the 'visitLog' collection. Records a volunteer's outreach visit (web version).

uid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the volunteer who created this log.

whenVisit.description: Date and time of the visit as a formatted string (e.g., '5/16/2023 3:23:51').

whereVisit.description: Description of where the outreach visit took place.

otherNotes.description: General free-text notes about the visit.

numberPeopleHelped.description: Number of people helped during the visit.

numberPeopleJoined.description: Number of people who joined the volunteer.

rating.description: Volunteer's self-reported rating (stored as emoji stars string, e.g., '⭐️⭐️').

timeOutreach.description: Duration of the outreach in hours.

volunteerAgain.description: Whether the volunteer would go again.
